feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The evidence is iteration 1 (60 trials, all off_track, score 75.97, the best raced so far) and iteration 0 (score 26.04). In iteration 1, max_error stayed at about 0.061 to 0.065 on every track, line losses were about 2 per trial on the s-bend and slalom, and steering_oscillation rose to 0.23 on the s-bend and 0.14 on the slalom. Progress improved (s-bend 0.04 to 0.29, oval 0.115 to 0.16), so the tighter sensors and kp 2.0 helped. The candidate makes two changes, both in the direction the evidence supports: base_speed 1.4 to 1.2, which tests whether speed is causing the early line loss, and kd 0.2 to 0.1, which tests whether derivative noise is causing the high oscillation. The sensor geometry, weights, kp and line_loss are unchanged, so each effect can be read from the race. Every field is inside its contract limits and the sensor and weight counts match. Nothing is obviously broken, so this is a valid, targeted step. Watch two things in the telemetry. First, progress may fall if the lower speed does not move the failure point later, since it is the main score driver while runs end off-track. Second, a lower kd may cut damping and push max_error back up. Next-step rules: if steering_oscillation falls and max_error stays near 0.06 with line losses low, raise kp in steps (2.0 to 2.5). If oscillation is still high with kd 0.1, lower kd to 0.05. If progress drops without a gain in max_error, return base_speed toward 1.4 and keep kd at 0.1. Keep ki at 0 unless rms_error shows a steady offset.
requested_changes: After the race, if steering_oscillation falls below about 0.15 and max_error stays near 0.06, raise kp from 2.0 to 2.5 in one step (iteration 1 showed kp 1.5 to 2.0 reduced max_error only slightly, so the next step should be modest).
If steering_oscillation is still above about 0.15 with kd at 0.1, lower kd to 0.05 (iteration 1 showed kd 0.2 coincided with oscillation of 0.23 on the s-bend).

If progress falls below the iteration 1 levels (s-bend 0.29, oval 0.16) with no reduction in max_error, return base_speed toward 1.4 and keep kd at 0.1, since speed then looks like a limit on the bend count and not the cause of line loss.
